en.headline: Star Voyager cancels remaining 2026 Hong Kong sailings
en.dek: Star Cruises has dropped 17 autumn departures from Ocean Terminal after a change in regional deployment, and has scheduled the ship on Southeast Asian routes from Singapore and Malaysia instead.
body: Star Cruises has cancelled 17 remaining 2026 sailings of Star Voyager from Hong Kong, after telling passengers last week that a change in its regional deployment plan meant the autumn programme from Ocean Terminal in Tsim Sha Tsui could not go ahead as advertised.

The cancelled itineraries were due to run from 30 September to 15 November and included two- to five-night trips to Xiamen, Sanya, Kaohsiung and Penghu, and Okinawa. Affected passengers may take a full refund or transfer to any Star Cruises sailing departing on or before 29 August next year, the company said.

Days after the cancellation notices, the line announced a Southeast Asia season for Star Voyager from 25 September to 1 January, with departures from Singapore, Kuala Lumpur and Melaka that do not call at Hong Kong. Star Cruises told Ming Pao it had no plan to withdraw from the city and would keep assessing a return in 2027 and beyond.

The Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau described the change as a common commercial practice in the cruise industry. Ming Pao, checking Ocean Terminal schedules, reported no further Star Voyager calls listed there through 2029 after the ship’s latest Hong Kong departure.

zh.headline: 領航星號取消今年剩下香港航次 調往東南亞
zh.dek: 麗星郵輪因區域部署變動，取消領航星號原定9月30日至11月15日由尖沙嘴海運碼頭出發的17個航次，改由新加坡及馬來西亞出發。
body: 麗星郵輪宣布取消領航星號今年剩下由香港出發的航次。公司上週通知旅客，因區域部署計劃變動，原定以尖沙嘴海運碼頭為母港的秋季航程無法如期開出。
受影響航次共17班，原定於9月30日至11月15日出發，包括兩晚至五晚前往廈門、三亞、高雄及澎湖、沖繩等航線。麗星表示，受影響旅客可選擇全額退款，或改搭明年8月29日前出發的任何麗星郵輪航次。
取消通告發出後數日，麗星公佈領航星號東南亞航季，9月25日至明年1月1日由新加坡、吉隆坡及馬六甲出發，並不掛靠香港。公司回覆明報時強調無計劃撤出香港，亦會繼續評估明年及以後在港部署。
文化體育及旅遊局表示，有關調整屬郵輪業常見商業運作。明報查閱海運碼頭船期表後報道，領航星號最近一班香港出發後，表上至2029年未見再有泊港安排。
